body: Immediate UX leads (authoritative sources verified): (1) presenter/second-device UI must reflow at 320 CSS px without loss or 2D scrolling per WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.10: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/reflow.html. (2) interactive targets must be >=24x24 CSS px or sufficiently spaced per SC 2.5.8; for live-operation controls I recommend a stronger 44-48px product target: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/target-size-minimum.html. (3) keyboard focus needs a 2 CSS px-equivalent perimeter and >=3:1 contrast per SC 2.4.13: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/focus-appearance.html. (4) sync/connection/audience-count changes should be programmatic status messages without moving focus per SC 4.1.3: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/status-messages.html. Full IA/recovery synthesis follows.
